A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same PSHuman research work, with complete main text, references and supplementary Sections 6–9. Text extraction and visual inspection support comparison of all 19 pages, including equations, tables and figures.

before.justification: v2 reports original reconstruction benchmarks and ablations in Tables 1–5, plus inference timings, a user study and supplementary qualitative experiments.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, inference timings and the 20-volunteer user study.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same body-face cross-scale diffusion, noise blending, SMPL-X conditioning, explicit mesh carving and appearance fusion. No algorithmic component, objective or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use THuman2.1 and CustomHumans for training and retain the same CAPE, THuman2.1, SHHQ and in-the-wild evaluations. Supplementary occlusion, lighting, age-group and anime scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within the main tables, user study and qualitative comparisons. The supplementary comparison in Figure 11 retains Magic123, Dreamgaussian, Chupa and TeCH; Figure 17 retains Sapiens-2B and ECON.

E3.justification: Sections 4 and 8 retain the same splits, metrics, training budgets, SMPL-X conditions and testing procedures. Evaluation still uses 60 THuman2.1 scans and 150 CAPE scans; the user study still uses 40 images and 20 volunteers.

E4.justification: The conditioning, cross-scale diffusion and mesh-carving ablations are unchanged, as are the view-count comparison and supplementary robustness analyses. Tables 2, 4–5 and Figures 7–19 contain the same relevant evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate reporting and user-study scores. Neither reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All result entries in Tables 1–7 and the qualitative examples match. For example, PSHuman's THuman2.1 Chamfer distance with the body prior remains 0.4399 cm in Table 1, and its appearance PSNR remains 20.8548 in Table 3.

T1.justification: The distribution and diffusion formulations in Equations 1–6, reconstruction objectives in Equations 7–9, and supplementary Section 6 reasoning about the approximated forward process are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about reconstruction quality, facial fidelity, pose robustness and efficiency. No claim is added, removed or substantively qualified.

C2.justification: Interpretations of the ablations and generalization results are retained. Section 5 preserves the same limitations concerning pose-estimation errors, incorrect novel-view generation, loose hair and hands; supplementary explanations and ethical discussion also match.

D1.justification: Sections 4 and 7 retain the same hyperparameters, hardware, training duration, preprocessing and inference instructions. The project address and other code or resource access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 54 numbered references and research positioning are retained. Section 2 makes the same comparisons with implicit, explicit and diffusion-based human reconstruction approaches.

P1.justification: The acknowledgement changes NSFC No.62171255 to No.62422110, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. Scientific prose, terminology, section ordering and supplementary structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–21 and Tables 1–7 retain their displays, captions, arrangements and placement. Rendered-page comparison shows the same layout, apart from negligible glyph-rendering differences.

improvement.justification: v3 updates the acknowledgement grant number and version stamp while preserving the scientific content, empirical evidence, reproducibility details and limitations throughout the main paper and supplement. These administrative changes do not establish a meaningful overall quality gain or loss.
